(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating __the__ one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

(Cancelled) Claim 2: The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by __obtaining the collected shed cellular material at a first temperature, followed by exposing the collected shed cellular material to a second temperature and then performing agitation__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by heating __the shed cellular material and performing agitation__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises __performing a DNA extraction process__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more __immature plant__ embryos.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __a type of genotyping process__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 17: The method of claim 1 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on __the obtained genotype__.
